description: Header file defining the MultiThreadedCertVerifier class, which implements a multi-threaded certificate verifier in the net namespace, including class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies.

classes.name: MultiThreadedCertVerifier
classes.description: A class implementing a certificate verifier that runs synchronous verification on worker threads, supporting configuration, observer pattern, and update mechanisms.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification asynchronously with provided parameters and callback.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to listen for verifier events.

methods.name: UpdateVerifyProcData
methods.description: Updates the verification process data with new fetcher and parameters.

methods.name: NotifyCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of changes in the verifier.
